reason: Expands the usage_logs request_type check constraint to allow cyber-policy blocked requests to be recorded as type 4.
risk: Dropping and recreating the check constraint can briefly lock usage_logs and leaves the replacement constraint unvalidated for historical rows.
mitigation: The replacement only broadens the accepted values, is added NOT VALID to avoid a blocking historical scan, and the currently deployed code remains compatible because it writes only the previously accepted request types.
